🍿 **A Quick Note on Watch Party Rooms**
We noticed a few of you accidentally creating Watch Party Rooms while tapping to download videos! 😅 

If you find yourself solo in a room, **Rooms** are designed for streaming together with friends by sharing your room link or code. If you just want to watch or download on your own, you can stream directly from the main player screen. We are adjusting the UI layout in the next update to give the buttons more breathing room!
